content:
**BCISB:** BCI105/2025-2026

**Date:** March 25

th , 2026

**Subject:** Term 3 ECAs, 2025-2026

**To:** Parents and Guardians of BCISB Students

Dear Parents and Guardians,

As we prepare to start round 3 of ECAs for the 2025-2026 academic year, we would like to remind

you of some important ECA protocols and share the upcoming sign-up dates and links.

**Internal ECAs:** Our

internal ECAs (Extra-Curricular Activities) will continue to be available in a paid format at

2,000 Baht each. We are committed to delivering high-quality lessons that our teachers

thoughtfully design. At the end of each ECA's cycle, teachers will provide students with a progress

report or a showcase, enabling you to track your child's development.

**External ECAs:** Our

external ECAs will continue as usual, offering the same enriching opportunities you expect

each year

**ECA Cycles and Schedule:**

Term 3: April 27

th

- June

19

th , 2026

PM - 3:30 PM

**Elementary/MS/HS ECAs:** 3:00 PM - 4:00 PM

**ECA Lists:** ECA lists are attached to this email.

Kindly note that all ECA payments are non-refundable, and class changes will not be

permitted after the official announcement on the Seesaw system.* Timely payment and

submission are required to secure your ECA placement.

Thank you for your continued support and cooperation. We look forward to another exciting and

productive term ahead.

If you have any questions or require additional information, please don't hesitate to contact us.

Mr Ivan Smith

Athletic Director/PYP Coordinator

title: telegram unavailable
content:
Dear Parents,

Please be informed that due to technical difficulties, the student face-scan notification service via Telegram Notify is temporarily unavailable. The school is currently working to resolve the issue as quickly as possible. We will provide further updates once the system is back in operation. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

Kind regards,

​

IT Department

British Columbia International School Bangkok (BCISB)

​
